about_the_game:
Command your Crusader and their Faction to Victory! through the dangerous and intriguing universe of the Zeta Sector in this Unique RTS Hybrid!

Strategic Gameplay with a Twist:

RTS gameplay with a fresh twist! Blend resource management, base-building, and real-time combat.

Power-up!:

Gain unique Power Ups! from defeated foes to help survive an overwhelming Enemy threat

Crusader Girls:

Build Relationships with the Crusader girls, each with unique quirks and charms. Unlock special Content and bonuses as you grow closer. 

Loot:

Gain Blueprints and Equipped to help improve your odds as you continue to gather more power.

5 Unique Factions

Play between 5 visual and functionally different factions,From Sentient Living Rocks

Hive minded Aliens,Crazed Human Zealot's,And Monster Girls!.

content_descriptors.notes: Cartoon Violence ,Adult Humor, Provocative Clothing ,Suggestive poses.

detailed_description:
Feature List

First Ever RTS you can play with a Fightstick!

Fightstick and Arcade Stick compatible and recommended over Gamepad

Color Change units and structures!

Freely color change units and structures on the fly

Unique Units and Faction GamePlay!

Each of the 5 factions will play drastically different from one another! 

Loot Drops and power ups!

Wave base loot drop system and power ups to help alter your crusader's!

Item Modification!

Use items in game to change their propriety's to give you various effects to your build loadouts and strategies
